item.title: She Lured Her Fiancé’s Lover Into A Deadly Ambush
item.description: After Antonetta Stevens discovered her fiancé was having an affair with Ashley Bocanegra, investigators said she and her sister-in-law lured Ashley to a Georgia apartment complex. The two women then attacked her, and Ashley later died from her injuries.

item.title: She Investigated The Underworld Then Vanished Without A Trace
item.description: Susan Walsh disappeared from her New Jersey home in July 1996 after telling her estranged husband she would only be gone briefly. Her work had taken her into New York's underground sex industry, where she investigated alleged Russian organized crime and a subculture involving self-described vampires. Nearly three decades later, she has never been found.
